story_title: AI Agents Resolving Digital Threats 100x Faster
caption:
AI agents are pushing cybersecurity into a new dimension. OpenAI reports that security platform Outtake uses GPT-4.1 and OpenAI o3 to resolve digital threats 100x faster than traditional workflows.

As threat detection moves from hours to seconds, autonomous agents are shifting from optional tools to mandatory infrastructure.

What's your take—are you ready to let AI agents handle threat resolution autonomously? 👇

Slide 2: MANUAL TRIAGE IS TOO SLOW.. Digital attacks propagate in seconds, while human analysis can take hours or days. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 5: 100×. This isn't just an incremental patch—it represents a structural shift toward fully autonomous digital defense. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 6: THE SHIFT TO AUTONOMOUS DEFENSE.. As reasoning models like OpenAI o3 improve, agentic workflows will handle routine security incidents entirely without human intervention. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.
